name: Breadcrumbs: Still Here
source:
One woman, one story. A single romance, not a roster to collect. "Making love," not "having sex". "The love of your life" not "one-night stand". Slices of life, in all their beauty and all their ugliness. Imperfect, because that is what makes us authentic. Made by your fellow weebo gooner o7.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486690/Breadcrumbs_Still_Here/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一位女性，一段故事。只专注唯一一段恋情，而非集邮式的后宫图鉴；是“做爱”，而非单纯“上床”；是“此生挚爱”，而非“一夜风流”。在生活切片之中，尽显其全部美好与全部狼狈。正因并不完美，才更显真实动人。来自你的同好宅男老色批敬上o7。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486690/Breadcrumbs_Still_Here/]Steam[/url]]
